title: Uncle Walter and the Italian Bijou family
summary: Howard names his uncle Walter, a pianist who wrote, and the Italian Bijou family whose playing he listened to as a boy.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So what was your uncle's first name?
Walter.
Do you remember, was he a pianist, or did he play piano and trombone?
A little bit.
Did he write like your rather did?
Yes, he could write.
That would mean that maybe their parents had --
Well, maybe so. My grandparents or not, I can't remember. It's too long ago.
It seems to be in the family, your father --

But I do remember one thing about it, and this might do you some good, but I doubt it. The Bijou people, that was the name of them. They were Italian people that played instruments, and they would come down to the store and things like that, and sit down there and listen to them play. And that's how I started to learn.
Is that a family?
Yeah, Bijou. That was a family.
Is that who you studied with? Was that one of the teacher?

There was a teacher, but I didn't study with them. I couldn't give them that credit, because that would be wrong, because my uncle got ahold of me before that. That's all there was to it, there wasn't nothing else to it. I just had to bring that in because I remember the Bijous.
Good.
They were Italian people, very fine people. I had to tell you about them, because they played at nighttime during -- what do you call it - Shitokwa. A certain type of music. That's right.
I've heard it. That's what you were studying.
Yeah, when I came out west.
Can you sing any of that?
No, I don't think so. I might have at that time, but I couldn't do it now. But I learned a lot from them people.
Italian musicians are outstanding, they study all the operas and other things.
Yeah, they studied all the operas.
